customize.text: Hroptatyr was the president of the Universitas Magistrorum, the Chief Royal Mage known as "The Wise" by royal appointment, and the most favored among the Four Pillars of Khaenri'ah.

customize.name: Five Sinners
customize.desc: Five prominent figures of Khaenri'ah, who shared the power of the Abyss, capable of destroying an entire world, among themselves.

customize.text: Hroptatyr shared the Abyssal powers capable of destroying the world with four other prominent Khaenri'ahns and became a Sinner. He renounced his humanity, left Teyvat, and ventured into the depths of the universe to merge with the Abyss and acquire infinite knowledge.

customize.name: Pierro
customize.desc: The first Fatuus, also known as The Jester. He was a royal mage in Khaenri'ah and was cursed with immortality. His real name is Eftirvit.

customize.text:
Hroptatyr and Eftirvit were once friends, but they began to drift apart following the death of their mentor, Mimameith. Due to the crimes committed against his own people, Eftirvit views his former friend as a monster.
Before leaving Teyvat, Hroptatyr gave Eftirvit his notebook, in which he had left behind his humanity, a fragment of memories from his youth, before he became a Sinner. This version of Hroptatyr helped Eftirvit refine a Delusion into an Eye of the Fatui, enabling him to defeat the Ruler of Death.
